channel.description: Last 10 notes on Dong Xing's Blog

item.title: Radix Sort
item.description: Radix Sort is an algorithm that sorts an array of n integers a_0,a_1,\dots,a_{n-1}\in\{0,1,\dots,m^d-1\} in non-decreasing order in \mathcal{O}(d(n+m)) time and \mathcal{O}(n+m) space.

item.title: Bluestein's Algorithm
item.description: Bluestein’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes f(z^0),f(z^1),\dots,f(z^{m-1}) for a polynomial f(x)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}a_ix^i in \mathcal{O}((n+m)\log(n+m)) time and \mathcal{O}(n+m) space.

item.title: Knuth-Morris-Pratt Algorithm
item.description: The Knuth-Morris-Pratt Algorithm is an algorithm that computes \pi(1),\pi(2),\dots,\pi(n) for a string s of length n, where \pi(i)=\max\{j:j<i\land s_0s_1\dots s_{j-1}=s_{i-j}s_{i-j+1}\dots s_{i-1}\} in \mathcal{O}(n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.

item.title: Manacher's Algorithm
item.description: Manacher’s Algorithm is an algorithm that computes d(0),d(1),\dots,d(n-1) for a string s of length n, where d(i)=\max\{j:i-j\ge0\land i+j<n\land s_is_{i-1}\dots s_{i-j}=s_is_{i+1}\dots s_{i+j}\} in \mathcal{O}(n) time and \mathcal{O}(n) space.
